items.title: Luther Henderson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was recommended by Irving Townsend to do this album with Polly which I did

ctx.x: No, I was gonna ask you who she was.

All right. Helen Morgan was what you would call a chanteuse. She was, she sang in the posh nightclubs. You picture Helen Morgan spread alluringly across a piano with a long cigarette holder in her hand singing My Man … The Man I Love or singing some torch song or something like that, you see? This was what Helen Morgan … she became very famous with that. And her life was quite interesting and so forth. Won't go through all that. But then her story was run. So evidently they wanted to do an album of her songs with…
